messages:
maria: Heads-up: Solstice Models wants Redwood to list their Solstice-13B-v2 model in the marketplace bundled with EdgeCore Lite hardware and Stratus Systems as the integration SI. Key asks: redistribution permission, bundle SKU & pricing, embargo date, and who owns support for on-prem installs.

riley (Legal): We need a simple redistribution schedule and a short consumer-facing license blurb. Solstice gave us a permissive research-use license but has a commercial redistribution addendum request. Draft clause we want to propose to them:

Redistribution Addendum (proposed wording):
Solstice grants Redwood a limited, non-transferable right to distribute the Model Artifact to Redwood customers for hosting and marketplace delivery. Redistribution must carry the original license and a provenance manifest. Customers must accept the Model Usage Notice during checkout; Redwood will facilitate but not amend Solstices license.

This is a starting point  Ill send a redline. Also flagging export-control check for EdgeCore hardware chips.

katie (GTM): For launches: Solstice wants a small 1-week co-marketing window with partner quotes and one joint webinar. Proposed embargo: 2027-02-10 08:00 PT. GTM needs final screenshots and a 150-word description by 2027-01-18. Who owns the example screenshots?

sam: Engineering notes: packaging options accepted by EdgeCore: model-wheel (.whl), OCI image, or signed tar.gz. For reproducibility we need a provenance.json containing: `model_release`, `quant_profile`, `provenance_sha256`, `license_uri`, `training_data_notice`. Example minimal manifest:
```json
{"model_release":"solstice-13b-v2","quant_profile":"int8-ptq","provenance_sha256":"3b7f...","license_uri":"https://solstice.ai/licenses/solstice-13b-v2.txt","training_data_notice":"See license for dataset details"}
```
Also note: EdgeCore HW only supports int8 symmetric and int4 channel-wise for EdgeCore-Lite. We need partner confirmation if int4 is allowed to redistribute.

punit: Legal/Compliance asks: add a consumer-facing "limitations of use" short text and an approvals checkbox for benchmark/perf claims. Also insist on a provenance SHA inside the top-level bundle and a signed attest.pem.

devrel: I'll build two quickstarts: one for OCI deploy to k8s and one for local EdgeCore via the wheel. Each will include a small smoke test program that runs a sample prompt and validates output signature if available. I'll put repos under redwood-examples/solstice-edgecore and include CI to run smoke tests on PRs. ETA? 2027-01-25.

infra-bot: task created: PARTNERS-4907 "Solstice-EdgeCore marketplace bundle: licensing + bundle SKU + provenance" assigned to riley, sam, katie, devrel. Due 2027-01-18.

maria: Owners: Legal (riley) -> signable addendum and consumer notice; GTM (katie) -> assets & copy; Eng (sam) -> packaging formats & manifest; DevRel (devrel) -> quickstarts + smoke tests. Compliance (punit) -> provenance spec and attestations. Please respond with 'ack' + ETA.

riley (Legal): ack  draft redistribution addendum by 2026-12-05, final by 2026-12-22.

sam: ack  packaging and manifest schema by 2026-12-08; will confirm int4 redistribution with EdgeCore by 2026-12-10.

katie (GTM): ack  assets + 150-word copy by 2027-01-18; will get partner logo pack by 2026-12-15.

devrel: ack  quickstarts + CI by 2027-01-25 (pushed because of holiday sprints).

punit: ack  provenance spec and attest.pem requirement confirmed by 2026-12-12; will coordinate export-control screening.

maria: Great. One open question: revenue share & pricing SKU. Solstice proposed a 70/30 split for engine usage revenue. Finance needs to confirm if that fits marketplace economics. I'll loop @finance next.

sam: small technical note: if we include the wheel we should embed a minimal metadata file `METADATA.toml` with `name`, `version`, `compatible_hw`, `recommended_batch_size`. Helps SI installs.

riley (Legal): Also: any public benchmark numbers included in the listing require Solstice sign-off and a signoff field in the addendum. We won't publish numbers without approval.

maria: ok closing for now  I'll schedule a 20m follow-up after legal shares the first redline. Thanks all.
